findings.text: blocking: the reproducibility test pops the benchmarks/efit_forward_parity_slice.py entry from sources before comparing the banked three-spacing receipt to a regenerated one, so the banked artifact's benchmark revision is no longer checked, and the staleness it hid is real (banked 84ba8502 versus current c080447a in both base and head); the coordinator resumed this run and ruled the banked digest comparison must remain strict, so the assertion must be restored before the node lands.

gate_arms_note: added_failure_count and added_failure_ids are derived with reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs from the reviewed run's own declared baseline_suite log (baseline-suite.log, revision f2bac518e470 / EXIT=1) and after_suite log (after-suite.log, revision 3a1c0bd41711 / EXIT=1). Each arm fails only the pre-existing banked-receipt test (test_three_spacing_receipt_is_banked_and_reproducible), so after FAILED minus base FAILED is empty and added_failure_count is a measured 0. The reviewed revision pair recorded here is base f2bac518e470 / head 4f92683f697e (the revision this review read); the run's declared after arm was later advanced to 3a1c0bd41711 when the coordinator restored the strict comparison, and that same pre-existing failure is the only one on both arms.

item_verdicts.diff: read f2bac518e470 against 4f92683f697e commit by commit (013fcc427 adds estimate_observable_discretisation_error and its two tests, 4f92683f adds the figure and fragment); 1360 insertions and 1 deletion, of which 1216 lines are the generated SVG.
item_verdicts.done_when: the estimator clause names an analytic fixture's known error order and magnitude within a stated factor; tests/test_derived_convergence_criterion.py:271-286 asserts observed_order within 0.1 of the closed-form 2.0 and the estimated-over-true error ratio within a factor of 2, and the refusal clause is asserted at :292-296.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is a non-circular, spacing-independent discretisation-error estimate of one observable across a resolution ladder; benchmarks/derived_convergence_criterion.py:300-381 adds estimate_observable_discretisation_error, which fits the order from the coarse differences only and holds out the finest pair for the qualification ratio and the Richardson estimate.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names both commits, the changed paths, the fragment and its own gate log, and its account matches the code and the logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the run declares benchmarks/derived_convergence_criterion.py, tests/test_derived_convergence_criterion.py, docs/figures/discretisation-error-estimator, docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-forward-onboarding/dfo-error-estimator.html and docs/figures/diiid-forward-onboarding/dfo-error-estimator; every path in the diff is inside them.

justifications.durability: the new assertions are falsifiable and the recorded negative control reddens the order guard, but tests/test_derived_convergence_criterion.py:243-246 narrows the pre-existing banked-receipt reproducibility check by dropping the benchmarks/efit_forward_parity_slice.py source pin, removing a guard that was catching real staleness.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's committed-gate.log records 16 passed at EXIT=0 for revision 4f92683f697e and negative-control-committed.log records the analytic assertion reddening at EXIT=1 with an independent failing id; the reviewed run declares no baseline_suite or after_suite arm, so the added-failure count is unmeasured, and part of the green came from narrowing a pre-existing check.
justifications.fit: the function follows the module idiom (numpy arrays, a dict[str, float | int] return, a sentence ValueError) matching circular_richardson_collapse at benchmarks/derived_convergence_criterion.py:279, and carries no plan or sprint identifier in any name or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: benchmarks/derived_convergence_criterion.py:300 builds the order from coarse_spacing and coarse_differences at :331-341 and uses the held-out finest pair only at :352-378, so it is non-circular, and tests/test_derived_convergence_criterion.py:288-291 shows the order and the estimate are invariant under a x1000 spacing rescale.
justifications.reuse: benchmarks/derived_convergence_criterion.py:22-23 imports _fit_power_order and richardson_fine_error and reuses both at :333 and :365; a search of benchmarks/ found no other discretisation-error estimator owner, so the change extends the existing owner rather than forking a mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-status f2bac518e470 4f92683f697e is exactly the four declared paths (M benchmarks/derived_convergence_criterion.py, M tests/test_derived_convergence_criterion.py, A docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-forward-onboarding/dfo-error-estimator.html, A docs/figures/discretisation-error-estimator/analytic-observable-error.svg), with nothing under nova/ touched.
